verdict.rationale: Spline's first-party docs describe a built-in AI Agent that builds and edits 3D scenes through the editor itself, handling objects, materials, lighting, animation and interactivity. A parallel AI Agent in the Hana 2D canvas designs screens from a description, and these are complemented by AI textures and AI 3D generation. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the agent completes delegated tasks reliably (all evidence is vendor docs).
